raw_response:
I been growing chili here in Quzhou my whole life. My father grew it, I grew it, same way. 2.2 mu is not much land but it's enough for me and my wife and my son who works in town.

I don't read, I don't write. I watch what works. My neighbor Old Wang, he has good chili every year, I do what he does more or less.

For seed — I buy the red chili seed from the dealer in town. He gives me the same kind every year, it's a good one, the peppers are long and red. Not the old village seed my father used, that one gives small peppers, buyers don't want. I pay maybe 30-40 yuan for enough seed for my 2.2 mu.

Fertilizer — this is the big cost. I plough the land and put compound fertilizer before planting. I use maybe 2 bags of compound fertilizer (50 jin each bag, so 50 kg) for my 2.2 mu, that's the base. Then when the chili is growing and starting to flower, I put urea, maybe 1 bag (50 jin) spread across the season, two times. My neighbor does similar. If I put less, the plants look yellow and weak, I'm scared of losing the harvest. Better to put a bit extra — wasting fertilizer costs money but losing chili costs much more.

So per mu — the compound is about 23 kg per mu, that has N, P, K inside. Plus urea 23 kg per mu on top, urea is mostly nitrogen. I don't know exact numbers but roughly nitrogen is the most, maybe 15-17 kg per mu total, phosphorus and potassium from compound maybe 6-7 kg each per mu.

Water — I have the well, I irrigate when the soil is dry. Chili needs water especially when flowering and when peppers are setting. I irrigate maybe 6-7 times in the season. Rain is not enough here.

Pesticide — chili gets aphids, gets the rot disease, gets the worms. I spray maybe 5-6 times in the season. If I don't spray, the peppers get holes and black spots, nobody buys them. I use whatever the dealer gives me for chili.

Tillage — I plough the land before planting, always. Rotary by the small tractor, I pay someone to do it since I don't have my own.

Yield — good year I get 2500-3000 kg fresh chili per mu, bad year maybe 1800. I expect 2500 kg per mu this year if weather is okay.
